name: Dating Game: Sasha
source:
Dating Game: Sasha is a short completed game project that's basically a fan made simple dating sim/VN consisting in, guess what, your MC attending a date with Sasha, the one and only love interest in game, paying tribute to those good old dating sims. Attend your date, face your night out with Sasha and try to win her heart. But don't you think it's going to be that easy.

[From [url=https://antipodegames.itch.io/dating-sasha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
约会游戏：萨莎是一个简短完成的游戏项目，基本上是一个粉丝制作的简单约会模拟游戏/VN，其中包括，猜猜看，你的主持人与萨莎（游戏中唯一的爱人）约会，向那些古老的约会模拟游戏致敬。 参加你的约会，与萨莎一起度过美好的夜晚，并尝试赢得她的心。但你不认为这会那么容易吗？

[来自[url=https://antipodegames.itch.io/dating-sasha]Itch.io[/url]]
